name: gurikaabe-mobile
description: GuriKaabe — Android shell (Capacitor) around the GuriKaabe PWAs.

scripts.build: node build-www.mjs && node configure-android.mjs && cap copy android
scripts.sync: node build-www.mjs && node configure-android.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.run:device: node build-www.mjs && node configure-android.mjs && cap sync android && cap run android
